integrity: The publisher full text was inspected at the UTLD density, Type-II log-likelihood, score, displayed second derivative, inverse-information confidence-interval construction, and parameter-domain statement. The correction is obtained by direct differentiation of the source's own log-likelihood and independently replayed in the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the displayed observed-information formula and does not reconstruct all numerical software used in the article.
Expected Fisher information is not derived; the result concerns the observed Hessian of the realized Type-II likelihood.
Other analytic formulas in the article are outside this finding.
title: The UTLD Type-II observed information hardcodes three failures and misses a scale factor
